cost: A args: flags O(A log A) map comparisons and copies; prepare O(B+normalization); score O(B+W log W) maps per sentence, O(W) pointers/map; filesystem commands retain full input/output text and vectors; split sorts F paths O(F log F).
description: Argument slice routes commands. flags consumes '--name value' pairs with empty missing value and last duplicate overwrite. Part parses inclusive chapter bounds, invalid chapter text becomes whole-book. prepare normalizes FORM/text and chooses Type or UPOS as XPOS. score aligns matching unpointed pieces within token positions and maps dependency heads.
forward: Argument slice routes commands. flags consumes '--name value' pairs with empty missing value and last duplicate overwrite. Part parses inclusive chapter bounds, invalid chapter text becomes whole-book. prepare normalizes FORM/text and chooses Type or UPOS as XPOS. score aligns matching unpointed pieces within token positions and maps dependency heads.
inverse: flags cannot distinguish a flag-looking next token from a value; malformed chapter part does not reject. score cannot align partial pieces within a mismatched token; same sentence count alone cannot validate identities.

Flags map admits duplicate overwritten options and arbitrary order; Part(chapters=None) admits book-only and malformed chapter strings. Tally admits many tree pairs; equal counts/F1 are not recoverable trees or semantic equivalence.
limitations: Finite supplied-input checks only; no corpus, training, external annotator, GPU, throughput or semantic-understanding claim. Allocation exhaustion and malformed arbitrary model arithmetic are not exhaustively exercised. No useful numerical surrogate is implemented; future caps may only be 1/2/5/10% with a declared metric.
state: Pure-helper domain representable usize tallies and u32 chapter ranges. CLI IO/training/corpus/annotator paths modeled statically only. Word positions are1-based, root0; malformed head parsed0. Token identity check uses piece count/forms, not written token form or sentence IDs.
